content: शाब(व)र {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [शब(व)र-अण्] .²1 Savage, barbarous. .²2 Low, vile, base. .{@-रः@} .²1 An offence, a fault. .²2 Sin, wickedness. .²3 The tree called {%Lodhra%}. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a teacher and author of a well-known commentary (शाबरभाष्य) on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtras; see शबर. .{@-री@} A low form of the Prākrita dialect (spoken by mountaineers <ab>&c.</ab>).
